status_note: GATE-A BLOCKED (OB-29 2026-08-11) for the Xi-specific RH-free claim. Genuine circularity (PROMPT_LINT L5, RH-imported-via-divisor, a re-scan miss): E-neg's log-power-sum matching writes Xi=Xi(0)*prod(1-z^2/gamma_n^2) over REAL gamma_n = RH; E-pos's (H-div) forces every Xi-zero to be a real-limit of real zeros = RH before Montel/Hurwitz. Also: 'Xi/CCM det_reg are known members of E_N' is FALSE (Xi-membership = RH; CCM phase -i*lambda^{-iz} not even/real, no exact k_N/J_N match); 'R_N->inf' needs the unstated k_N->inf; radius anchors were leading-asymptotic (2*gamma_11=105.94, 2*gamma_10001=19757.3, not 54.5/13643). SURVIVES (RH-free): the IFT/scaled-Vandermonde/Cauchy machinery over an ABSTRACT Laguerre-Polya target L=C*prod(1-z^2/lambda_n^2) with a GIVEN real simple summable zero set (OB-29 Link A/B CONFIRMED given L); and the finite-order complete-divisor uniqueness lemma (Link D CONDITIONAL, once (H-uorder) r^{1+eps} + (H-div) precise). Specializing L=Xi is exactly RH and is NOT claimed. Reframed per OB-29 Path B. Positioned as a Paper C supporting section (abstract real-zero non-identifiability), NOT a standalone RH-free Xi-theorem.
